description: This file contains function prototypes and license information for the exported API of a UInt Array component within a BroadWay Service Delivery System. It defines functions for creating, removing, enrolling objects, and initializing instances of the component.

methods.name: AnscCreateUIntArrayComponent
methods.description: Creates a new UInt Array component instance using container, owner, and reserved handles.

methods.name: AnscUIntArrayCOCreate
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the UInt Array component with specified context and owner handles.

methods.name: AnscUIntArrayCORemove
methods.description: Removes or deletes the specified UInt Array component instance.

methods.name: AnscUIntArrayCOEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls or registers the necessary objects for the UInt Array component.

methods.name: AnscUIntArrayCOInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the UInt Array component instance.
